# Avsnitt 198 – Dags att gå till doktorn?

**Feed**: kvalitetsaktiepodden  
**Published**: 2026-11-18  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Kvalitetsaktiepodden episode 198 opens with a strong Q3 report season for the hosts' holdings: shares rose 5.1% on average after reports, led by Prevas and Kabe, with Note the weakest. The hosts argue that US midterm votes against data centers and Norway's Statnett pausing new grid capacity point to slower data-center build-outs, which hurts AI hardware suppliers but may help hyperscalers. They also cover new buyback rules for First North, NGM and Spotlight, Svolder's push for board members to own shares, and their exits from Huhtamäki (lost trust after a reporting adjustment) and Proact (hard year-on-year comparisons ahead), plus the Bahnhof takeover and the CEO change at Björn Borg.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 HUH1V — Huhtamäki | **SELL** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Hosts sold at a loss after a €23m one-off was left in comparable sales, turning 1% underlying growth into a reported 4%.

#### Reasoning

Reported Q3 comparable growth was 4%, but stripping out the €23m one-off item gives only 1%, after years of flat growth. The company usually adjusts away negative items yet kept this positive one in its own 'comparable' measure without warning investors. The terminated food-service contract will also cost €4-6m in profit going forward. Hosts lost trust in management's reporting and exited.

#### Sell Triggers

- if management corrects its comparable reporting and growth proves real
- if valuation re-rates toward historical levels

> *"Vi tappade förtroendet faktiskt för dem, så vi har sålt"*

---

### ⛔ TOKMAN — Tokmanni | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Profit warning with little information; other retailers see improving consumers, so this may be company-specific; hosts not tempted.

#### Reasoning

The company cut its sales guidance by 2.4% and EBIT guidance by 8.3%, warning mid-session the day before its report. The stock fell 12% and then rose 6.4% on the full report. Hosts dislike the poor communication. Several other retailers are talking about improving consumer demand, so the weakness may be a Tokmanni problem. It was their worst trade of 2025, and it would take a lot for them to re-enter.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Christmas trading surprises positively
- if like-for-like basket size recovers

> *"Ja, det ska nog till en del för att vi ska in där igen."*

---

### 🔴 PACT — Proact | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Hosts sold after EBIT rose more than 50%; very tough H1 2026 comparisons and unclear memory-price effects on margins.

#### Reasoning

Hosts bought at SEK 108 and the stock is now SEK 141. The profit jump is partly hard to explain (memory prices, a turnaround in Central and West) and management is cautious about the outlook. Q1-Q2 next year face very tough comparisons, and the market tends to swing hard on one or two weak reports. Hosts still like the business and the SEK 20 adjusted EPS target for 2030, and expect to buy back in later.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the share price falls back after weak quarters, giving a re-entry chance
- if margin strength proves durable against tough comparisons

> *"Så vi har faktiskt sålt våra aktier i Proact här"*

---

### 🟢 GOOGL — Alphabet | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Marcus bought more after the election-driven AI sell-off; hyperscalers may benefit from slower capex and higher capacity prices.

#### Reasoning

Political limits on data-center building in the US slow hyperscaler capex without the companies having to choose it themselves. That can lower technology input costs and raise prices for existing capacity, improving cash flows. Marcus has owned Alphabet for a long time and believes it will one day become the world's most valuable company, though search is under challenge.

#### Sell Triggers

- if search is materially disrupted
- if capex keeps rising without returns

> *"Jag köpte mer Alphabet då. Jag har ägt det länge."*

---

### 🟠 BORG — Björn Borg | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

CEO Bunge leaves 31 Mar 2027 for J.Lindeberg; hosts hope the transition makes the stock shaky enough to offer entry chances.

#### Reasoning

Hosts have traded Björn Borg in and out many times, but Bunge's strong execution left little opening. The CEO departure, with no successor named yet, could add volatility, which hosts see as a possible chance to get back in.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a strong successor is named and the business keeps executing without a pullback

> *"Kanske det är dags igen Att det blir lite skakigt i Borg här Så att vi får chanser"*

---

### 🟡 KABE-B — Kabe | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Stock +18% on the report; hosts repeat that comparisons stay easy through H2 2026, including the coming Q4.

#### Reasoning

This appears to be a holding (the season review covered companies the hosts own). The report was strong, and hosts repeated that comparisons stay easy in H2 2026, which supports the upcoming Q4.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q4 fails to beat easy comparisons

> *"Då sa vi att det var lätta kompisar under andra halvåret 2026 och det gäller fortfarande för deras Q4"*
